title: Models that act
lede: What changes when the output is an action, not an answer?
body: In 2021 WebGPT gave a model a text browser and taught it to search and cite. In 2022 ReAct combined reasoning and acting into one loop: think, act, observe, repeat. Almost every agent since is built on that loop. In 2023 SWE-bench asked models to fix real GitHub issues; the best of the day solved under 2 percent.

Then the tooling caught up. Function calling made tool use a standard API feature, computer use let a model operate a screen, and the Model Context Protocol standardised how models connect to tools. Coding agents became everyday tools in 2025, and reported SWE-bench scores passed 80 percent, though those figures are vendor-reported.
transition: Which brings the threads back together, in the present.
